name: Wisdom teeth
title: Wisdom teeth assessment and removal | South Cairns Dental, Edmonton
description: Pain, swelling or infection around a wisdom tooth? South Cairns Dental assesses wisdom teeth with a consultation and X-ray. Removal is not always necessary.

hero.title: Wisdom teeth
hero.lead: Wisdom teeth don’t always cause trouble, and they don’t always need to come out. A proper assessment tells you which situation you’re in.

intro.heading: Why wisdom teeth can cause trouble
intro.html:
Wisdom teeth are the last teeth to come through, usually in the late teens or twenties. If there isn’t enough room, they can stay partly or fully under the gum, or come through at an angle. This is often called an impacted wisdom tooth.

A partly erupted tooth can trap food and bacteria, leading to inflamed gums and infection. Many wisdom teeth cause no problems at all, which is why assessment comes before any decision.

callout.title: Swelling that spreads?
callout.html: Swelling that spreads to your eye or neck, or makes it hard to swallow or breathe, needs urgent medical attention. Call 000 or see our emergency page.

explain.heading: Signs a wisdom tooth may be causing problems
explain.intro: If you notice any of these, book an assessment.
ticks: Pain at the back of the mouth
Swelling of the gum or jaw
A bad taste or bad breath
Gum or tooth problems behind the wisdom tooth

process.heading: Assessment comes first
steps: Your dentist examines your mouth and takes an X-ray to see how the wisdom teeth are sitting, including any that haven’t come through.
You’ll be told whether the teeth are likely to cause problems, and whether removal is advised.
Your dentist explains the procedure, the costs and what recovery usually involves before you decide.

weigh.heading: Benefits and things to consider
benefits: Removal can stop repeated pain and infection
Can protect the tooth in front from decay or damage
consider: Recovery can involve swelling and discomfort for several days
Some cases are complex and may be referred to a specialist
As with any surgery, there are risks your dentist will explain
alternatives: Monitoring with regular check-ups and X-rays
Treating a flare-up of gum inflammation and reviewing

care.heading: If you have a wisdom tooth removed
items: Some swelling is normal and often peaks after a couple of days. A cold pack on the outside of the cheek may help.
Stick to soft foods and avoid the area when chewing.
Smoking, straws and vigorous rinsing in the first day or so.
If pain gets worse after a few days, you have a fever, or you notice a bad taste or swelling that is increasing.

faqs: Do all wisdom teeth need to come out?
No. If they’re healthy, in a good position and easy to clean, they can often stay. Your dentist will advise based on an examination and X-ray.
Our dentists Alex and Louie have a particular interest in wisdom teeth surgery. Some complex cases may be referred to a specialist, and your dentist will discuss this with you.
cost: The cost depends on what your mouth needs, so it can only be worked out after an examination.
